deliverables: one shared bibliographic writer used by both search paths, so A1 parity is structural instead of maintained by copy-paste
the evidence claim describes the material actually at hand (no assertion of an abstract that the same call records as absent)
a retrieved hit with no DOI, URL or provider id is refused rather than minted as E1 evidence, reported in diagnostics
a user-supplied seed without identifiers is still accepted: its provenance is the user's own file
partial provider failure is carried as a fact through the A4 boundary (receipt.provider_failure) so a run whose primary source never answered is distinguishable from a healthy one
discriminating tests for every clause above
